note: PROPOSED, NOT FROZEN. M03 adds no member to the frozen ErrorCode enum: every row below reuses an existing code and supplies a module-owned message_key. The frontend renders the key in English or Malayalam; the server never returns prose.

rows.when: The request carried an identity header. Rejected by shared transport before M03 sees it.
No server-derived session. Real authentication is M01's; standalone derives a fixed persona on loopback.
Publishing without ever having asserted a second factor.
Publishing with a second factor older than the reviewed 300-second window.
The actor may know the object exists but may not perform this action: an unassigned teacher reading another section's schedule, a teacher publishing.
Absent, or belonging to another school. The two are deliberately indistinguishable.
expected_version did not match the stored aggregate. Two academic heads publishing the same draft: one wins, one is told.
Editing a published or superseded version. A published grid is immutable; correcting it is a new revision.
Publishing a version that is no longer a draft.
Publishing while a blocking conflict stands. field_errors names each conflict code.
Publishing a version whose effective_from is not later than the currently effective version's effective_from. Retrospective republication would rewrite the schedule a past register was taken against.
Reading or substituting on a date no published version covers.
Assigning a substitute on a date with a holiday in force. A holiday has no eligible teaching period.
Assigning a substitute to a session already cancelled.
A second, non-withdrawn substitution for the same dated period. One period has one substitute.
Malformed body: a missing field, a wrong type, or an unknown field. Write bodies are closed at every nesting depth.
The body carried school_id, actor_id, auth_level or a resource grant. Rejected, never silently dropped.
A hand-edited or foreign pagination cursor.
A period template whose end is not strictly after its start.
Two period templates on the same weekday whose half-open [start, end) windows overlap.
Two period templates with the same weekday and slot code.
A slot naming a weekday and slot code the grid does not define.
Two slots for the same section in the same period. The database refuses it too; this is the readable form.
A version whose effective_to precedes its effective_from.
A slot naming a section Registry does not report for this school.
An unavailability interval whose end is not strictly after its start.
A substitution whose date is not the weekday its slot is taught on.
A substitution whose date falls outside the effective version's range.
Substituting a teacher for themselves.
A substitution valid beyond the end of its own school day. A substitution is a dated authority, never a standing class permission.
A substitution that would expire before the period it covers has finished.
A calendar range whose end precedes its start.
A calendar range longer than 400 days. Bounded so one request cannot expand an unbounded date walk.

conflict_codes.when: One teacher in two slots whose periods overlap on the same weekday, in any section.
One section in two slots whose periods overlap on the same weekday.
A slot whose teacher has a recorded unavailability covering that period on a date inside the version's effective range.
Two period templates on one weekday whose windows overlap. Also refused at write time; detected again here because a version may predate the rule.
A slot pointing at a period template the version no longer has.
Registry does not report the section for this school on the effective date.

Registry reports no dated teaching assignment for this teacher, section and subject. PROPOSED as non-blocking: schools commonly build the grid before recording assignments, and blocking would make the timetable depend on another module's data entry order. Review item 4.
